name: Static hero header
purpose: Identify the product and its parent company, and offer the two entry actions, without ever competing with the page as the reader scrolls.

companyHeading.note: An h2 carried for screen readers only.

structuralAnomaly.statement: There is NO <nav> element anywhere on this site, and this header is position:static with ZERO scroll behaviour — no sticky, no blur, no shrink, no shadow. It is a <header> placed in the hero's grid, and it scrolls away like any other content.
structuralAnomaly.rule: A generator MUST NOT add a nav element, a sticky header, or any scroll-reactive chrome.

knownOverflow.statement: At >=640px the header deliberately re-uses the hero's 17-column template, which makes it overflow at 768px. Reproduced from the original.

constraints.note: The FIRST node of the template is chrome.hairline-grid; this header is node 1. It is the first node carrying content.
